quickref.weapon: Frozen status (S'no Matter / Let It Cold hit)
quickref.status: BBG 2.15+ (Dec 20 2014) / 2.26+ (Jan 17 2017); seen in fan footage Oct 2015; 2026 unverified
quickref.look: In game: the victim sits inside a closed, faceted ice chunk, about as wide as it is tall. Its top is opaque white-lavender (#F8F6FB / #C0BBC6) and its lower half translucent teal (#287D7B; highlights #8DB2BE), with a dim figure and a green bar showing through; no overhead icon [Observed: uBXgVYop_-0 maxresdefault, Oct 24 2015, low-res; frozen-player identity Inference]. Concept (provenance unverified): a jagged white-capped teal mound catches the target's legs and back, not a full encasement [Observed concept].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: S'no Matter: a slow 'gray' projectile on a straight path at 800 u/s [Fan-wiki]; a white orb (#F0F2F5) is seen in flight [Observed: kRBhGYrQQ2U; identity Inference]. Let It Cold: missiles 'rain down' [Fan-wiki]; no image.
quickref.impact_end_result: Frozen for 2 s (S'no Matter) or 3 s (Let It Cold): cannot move or turn the camera, reloads restart, teammates freeze too [Fan-wiki]. Status Effects has no Frozen entry [Fan-wiki]. How the ice ends (shatter or melt) and any sound are unknown [Unverified].

quickref.status: BBG 2.15, Dec 20 2014; fan footage Oct 2015 (2.22); 2026 unverified
quickref.look: Menu render: a glowing white-cyan crystalline mass with a dark round muzzle (#FDFEFE / #CCFCFD) [Observed]. In-game HUD icon: grey body, pale ice-shard crest, cyan gem orbs, red rear wrap; it matches the concept's grey second variant, not the tartan one [Observed; match Inference].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 2 s rate of fire, ammo 3, 800 u/s, straight per the wiki, -10% move speed [Fan-wiki]; the concept lobs in an arc [Observed concept]; a white glowing orb is seen in flight with no trail [Observed; identity Inference].
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on any surface; 2 s freeze for everyone in the radius, teammates included [Fan-wiki]. The result is the white-and-teal ice chunk [Observed]. The burst look is unknown [Unverified].

quickref.status: BBG 2.26, Jan 17 2017; fan footage Jan 22 2017; 2026 unverified
quickref.look: A black striped bar across the shoulders, each end with two blue rockets (#2663D9, cone #2A2ADB), mint-green grinning faces, gold fuse sticks and cyan ice sparkles; HUD icon: a blue rocket with black fins, 0/4 [Observed].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Missiles that 'rain down'; 0.5 s, ammo 4, reload 4.0 s [Fan-wiki]; no image of flight [Unverified].
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosion (AoE 150/300) plus a 3 s freeze [Fan-wiki]; no image. It probably reuses the S'no Matter ice chunk [Inference].

quickref.status: BBG v2.16, Jan 30, 2015 [Fan-wiki: Updates]. In-play frames are from uploader-titled 2.25 videos (Mar 24 and Apr 27, 2016). Infobox changed from 35/s and 20 per 1.5 s to 25/s and 25 per 1 s in a Nov 11, 2020 wiki edit. In the 2026 re-release: Unverified.
quickref.look: Held: a glossy orange-brown slug or leech (#B36B44, dark rim #6D2919) with a small dark slit mark, about 0.35x Sanchez's height, in the prosthetic hand [Observed: File:Drainfield.jpg; size Inference]. Field: a giant deep-red creature head (#7B2825 to #9E3621) wearing dark-grey sunglasses (#4C4455) with white glints, with a ring of white triangular fangs (#F7ECEA). Two small black bat-like figures with glowing red eyes (#F50012) sit at its edge [Observed: xAp9gFMriAU hq1; 5twbNI7iakw maxres]. Concept art: a red-orange hooked blob with an eye patch or lens, wrapped in white swirl rings [Observed: File:Drainfield.png, fan-uploaded].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Tosses 'the leech-like creature that flies in an arc'; 800 u/s, ammo 1, reload 4.5 s [Fan-wiki]. HUD reads '1 / 1' [Observed: xAp9gFMriAU hq2, hq3]. The leech in flight, the launch effect and the sound were never seen [Unverified].
quickref.impact_end_result: Forms a field where it hits a solid surface. Enemies in range take 25/s and the user gets their lost health, with no overheal; shielded enemies give health but take no damage [Fan-wiki]. In play (2016) the field is the red, sunglasses-wearing, fanged creature projection, with a pale-pink haze (#E77A6D) rising from its mouth and red-eyed black bats at its edge. It is red, not the wiki's 'dark field' [Observed]. It stays up while Sanchez fires the Bind Gun at a slowed target inside it [Observed HUD; persistence Inference]. Heal transfer, kill and duration visuals: Unverified.

Sanchez throws a leech that 'flies in an arc', and the field forms where it lands; in play it appears as a giant red, sunglasses-wearing, fanged creature projection with red-eyed bats [Fan-wiki; Observed 2016]. Drain_Field says 'the Arbiter will toss the leech-like creature that flies in an arc' and 'the other fields are formed around the user while the Drain Field won't'. Frames: https://i.ytimg.com/vi/xAp9gFMriAU/hq1.jpg and https://i.ytimg.com/vi/5twbNI7iakw/maxresdefault.jpg [Observed].
